info.title: Seed Responses — API reference
info.description: Parameters and advanced features of Responses for Seed models.

post.description:
- Call Seed using the Responses API format.
- Keep context on the server and continue conversations with `previous_response_id` without resending the history.
- Mix text, images, video and PDF files. Only `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` also supports audio.
- Reasoning is on by default. You can disable it or adjust its depth.
- All models support function calls. Seed 2.1 and `doubao-seed-evolving` also support web search.
- Automatic caching is enabled by default. Use `caching` for explicit caching and `context_management` to manage context.
- Return structured JSON with JSON Object or JSON Schema.
- **Seed 2.0 legacy model names**: `doubao-seed-2.0-pro` / `doubao-seed-2.0-lite` are now routed to `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` and `doubao-seed-2.0-code` to `doubao-seed-evolving`; parameter behavior follows the new model. Use the new model names for new integrations. `doubao-seed-2.0-mini` is not affected
- [Quickstart](/en/api-manual/language-series/doubao-seed-2.0/doubao-seed-2.0-responses-quickstart)

model.description:
Choose a model

| Model ID | Use case | Context window |
|---|---|---|
| `doubao-seed-2-1-pro` | Recommended flagship for complex reasoning, long documents and codebases | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2-1-turbo` | Low-cost option for chat, extraction and agent tasks | 256,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` | Lowest-priced Seed 2.1 model, with audio input | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-evolving` | Updated weekly for evaluating new capabilities | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-pro` | Legacy model name, now routed to `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-lite` | Legacy model name, now routed to `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-mini` | Fastest Seed 2.0 model for simple tasks | 256,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-code` | Legacy model name, now routed to `doubao-seed-evolving` | 1,000,000 tokens |

Seed 2.1 model IDs use a hyphen (`2-1`). Seed 2.0 IDs use a period (`2.0`).

input.description:
Input content. Supports two formats:

**1. Plain text string**: Equivalent to text input from the user role

**2. Element list (array)**: Contains multiple input types including messages, context, tool calls, etc.

instructions.description:
Insert a system message or developer instruction as the first instruction in the model context

**Note**:
- When used with previous_response_id, instructions from the previous response are not inherited
- Cannot be used together with caching

previous_response_id.description:
Unique identifier of the previous model response, used to implement multi-turn conversations

**Note**:
- When provided, it will include the input and response content from the previous round, and the input tokens for the current request will increase accordingly
- In continuous multi-turn conversations, it is recommended to add approximately 100ms delay between each request

expire_at.description:
Expiry time for `store` and `caching`, in UTC Unix seconds. It must be after creation and at most 604800 seconds (7 days) later. Values outside that range return an error. Default: creation + 259200 seconds (3 days).

Explicit cache storage is billed upfront for the entire lifetime. Each clock hour touched is charged as a full hour, including partial hours. Early deletion is nonrefundable. Set an earlier `expire_at` for short-term reuse.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens including reasoning and the answer. Allow enough tokens for reasoning. If the budget runs out, `status` is `incomplete` and only reasoning may be returned.

thinking.description: Controls whether the model enables deep thinking mode

type.description: With `enabled`, the model reasons before answering (default for all Seed models). With `disabled`, it answers directly. Reasoning tokens count as output and are billed at the output rate.

reasoning.description: Limit deep thinking workload, reducing it can make responses faster and use fewer tokens

effort.description:
Reasoning effort: `minimal` answers directly, `low` prioritizes speed, `medium` balances speed and depth, and `high` analyzes complex problems in depth.

Seed 2.1 and `doubao-seed-evolving` default to `high`. Seed 2.0 defaults to `medium`. The alias `none` maps to `minimal`, and `xhigh` and `max` map to `high`.

caching.description:
Omit this field or use `disabled` for automatic caching. Prefixes shared with recent requests may be billed at the cache-hit rate with no storage fee. Hits are not guaranteed.

With `{"type": "enabled"}`, the current input is cached explicitly. Continue via `previous_response_id` and send `caching: {"type": "enabled"}` again on every turn. Hits use the cache-hit rate. Storage is billed separately for newly cached tokens × storage hours at the model’s rate, until `expire_at`.

Combining explicit caching with `instructions` or any tool other than functions (including web search) returns 400.

type.description:
Cache toggle

- `enabled`: Enable caching
- `disabled`: Disable caching

prefix.description:
Whether to only create a common prefix cache (model does not respond)

- `true`: Only create common prefix cache
- `false`: Do not create common prefix cache

store.description:
Whether to store the generated model response for later retrieval via API

- `true`: Store the current model response
- `false`: Do not store

stream.description:
Whether to stream the response content

- `false`: Return all content at once after the model finishes generating
- `true`: Return chunks progressively via SSE protocol, ending with a `data: [DONE]` message

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature, controls output randomness

- Value range: [0, 2]
- Lower values are more deterministic, higher values are more random
- It is recommended to adjust only one of temperature or top_p

**Note**: doubao-seed-2.0-pro and doubao-seed-2.0-lite are fixed at 1, manual specification will be ignored

top_p.description:
Nucleus sampling probability threshold

- Value range: [0, 1]
- It is recommended to adjust only one of temperature or top_p

**Note**: doubao-seed-2.0-pro and doubao-seed-2.0-lite are fixed at 0.95, manual specification will be ignored

text.description: Format definition for model text output

format.description: Specify the model text output format

type.description:
Format type

- `text`: Natural language (default)
- `json_object`: JSON object format
- `json_schema`: JSON format following a schema definition

name.description: JSON structure name (required when type is json_schema)

schema.description: JSON Schema format definition (required when type is json_schema)

strict.description: Whether to enable strict adherence mode

tools.description: All Seed models accept custom `function` tools. Only Seed 2.1 and `doubao-seed-evolving` support `web_search`. Seed 2.0 returns 400 if web search is declared. Other built-ins such as `doubao_app` and `knowledge_search` also return 400. Each search performed is billed separately from tokens at the source-specific model rate.

tool_choice.description:
Controls whether the model calls tools

**String mode**:
- `none`: Do not call tools
- `required`: Must call tools
- `auto`: Model decides (default)

**Object mode**: Specify a particular tool to call

max_tool_calls.description: Maximum tool rounds, from 1 to 10, with no call limit per round. Web search defaults to 3 rounds. This is a best-effort limit. The actual count depends on the model’s reasoning.

context_management.description: Context management strategy to help the model effectively utilize the context window

InputItem.description: Input element, can be a message, tool call information, tool return information, or chain-of-thought information

type.description:
Input type

- `message`: Message input
- `function_call`: Tool function call information
- `function_call_output`: Tool return information
- `reasoning`: Chain-of-thought information

role.description:
Message role (when type is message)

- `user`: User message
- `system`: System message
- `assistant`: Assistant message
- `developer`: Developer message (higher priority than user)

content.description: Message as a plain string or an array of text, image, video or file objects. Only `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` also accepts audio.

partial.description:
Continuation mode (assistant role only)

Set the last assistant message's partial to true, and the model will continue writing based on the content

arguments.description: JSON string of function arguments (required when type is function_call)

call_id.description: Unique ID of the function tool call (required when type is function_call/function_call_output)

name.description: Function name (required when type is function_call)

output.description: Tool output result (required when type is function_call_output)

id.description: Unique identifier for chain-of-thought information (when type is reasoning)

image_url.description: Image URL or Base64-encoded data URL

detail.description:
Image understanding detail level

- `low`: Low detail
- `high`: High detail
- `xhigh`: Ultra-high detail

image_pixel_limit.description:
Image pixel range limit

Takes priority over the detail field. Pixel range must be within [196, 36000000]

max_pixels.description:
Maximum pixel limit

- Before doubao-seed-1.8: (min_pixels, 4014080]
- doubao-seed-2.0: (min_pixels, 9031680]

min_pixels.description:
Minimum pixel limit

- Before doubao-seed-1.8: [3136, max_pixels)
- doubao-seed-2.0: [1764, max_pixels)

video_url.description: Video URL or Base64-encoded data URL

fps.description:
Frame extraction rate

- Value range: [0.2, 5]
- Higher values are more sensitive to visual changes
- Lower values use fewer tokens and are faster

file_data.description: Base64-encoded file content (single file must not exceed 50MB)

file_url.description: Accessible URL of the file (file must not exceed 50MB)

Tool.description: Tool definition. Select a function or web search with `type`.

type.description: `function`: custom function. `web_search`: web search, available only on Seed 2.1 and `doubao-seed-evolving`.

name.description: Function name (required when type is function)

description.description: For `function` tools, describe when the model should call the function.

parameters.description: Function parameters, in JSON Schema format (when type is function)

strict.description: Whether to enforce strict parameter validation (when type is function)

sources.description:
Sources for `web_search`.

- Omit to search the public web.
- Add any of `toutiao`, `douyin` and `moji` to include Toutiao articles, Douyin Baike and Moji Weather alongside the web.
- Use `["doubao"]` alone for Doubao Search. It cannot be combined with other sources.

Rates vary by source. Billing uses actual counts per source from `usage.tool_usage_details`.

limit.description: Maximum results per search (1–50). Applies to `web_search` and is ignored when `sources` is `["doubao"]`.

max_keyword.description: Maximum parallel keywords per search round (1–50). Applies to `web_search` and is ignored when `sources` is `["doubao"]`.

user_location.description: Location used for search. Applies to `web_search` and is ignored when `sources` is `["doubao"]`.

ToolChoiceObject.description: Specify a particular tool to call

type.description:
Tool type

- `function`: Custom function, requires the name field
- Other built-in tool names

name.description: Name of the tool to call (required when type is function)

type.description:
Strategy type

- `clear_thinking`: Thinking block clear
- `clear_tool_uses`: Tool call content clear

keep.description:
Content retention strategy

**String mode**: `all` (retain all chain-of-thought)

**Object mode**: Specify retention strategy

type.description:
Retention strategy type

- `thinking_turns`: Retain the most recent N rounds of chain-of-thought
- `tool_uses`: Retain the most recent N rounds of tool calls

exclude_tools.description: List of tool names that will not be cleared (when type is clear_tool_uses)

clear_tool_input.description: Whether to clear tool call arguments (when type is clear_tool_uses)

trigger.description: Threshold to trigger the clear strategy (when type is clear_tool_uses)

value.description: Trigger clearing when tool calls reach N rounds

status.description:
Response status

- `completed`: Generation completed
- `in_progress`: Generation in progress
- `incomplete`: Incomplete
- `failed`: Failed

output.description: Model output content list, including chain-of-thought output, message output, tool call output, etc.

instructions.description: System instructions used for this request

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether parallel tool calls are allowed

caching.description: Cache configuration for this request. `type=enabled` means an explicit cache was written and incurs storage charges.

expire_at.description: Expiry time for the stored response and explicit cache, in Unix seconds.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens, including cache hits.

cached_tokens.description: Input tokens served from cache, billed at the cache-hit rate.

audio_tokens.description: Audio input tokens, returned only for audio requests to `doubao-seed-2-1-lite`.

audio_cached_tokens.description: Audio input tokens served from cache on audio requests to `doubao-seed-2-1-lite`.

tool_usage.description: Actual server tool calls, returned when web search is used.

web_search.description: Number of web searches actually performed for this request.

tool_usage_details.description: Search counts by source, returned when web search is used.

web_search.description: Keys are search sources (`doubao`, `search_engine`, `toutiao`, `douyin`, `moji`). Each value is that source’s actual call count.

InputAudio.title: Audio input (`doubao-seed-2-1-lite` only)
InputAudio.description:
Only `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` accepts audio. Other models return `400`.

- Formats: mp3, wav, aac and m4a. Up to 25 MB per file and 120 minutes total per request.
- Audio is billed separately at about 6.25 audio tokens per second. Cached audio has a lower rate. See model pricing.

audio_url.description: Public audio URL or Base64 data URL, such as `data:audio/wav;base64,...`.

action.description: Search action and queries used for this call.

bearerAuth.description:
## All APIs require Bearer Token authentication ##

**Get API Key:**

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
